suite.note: All six upstream benchmark directories are carried: session-open, agent-continuation, terminal-io, long-session-browser, conversation-fold, active-stream-reconnect. Three required local adapters preserve upstream timing boundaries: session-history-adapter.ts (replaces upstream api/session-controller with SessionQueryEngine/observeSession plus the apiproxy model-selection projection), conversation-fold/runtime-client-shim.ts (inlines client-runtime leaf modules into the plain-Node worker), and the sdk-minimal launch shape in agent-continuation workers.

measurements.name: session-open
measurements.evidence: 17/17 tests pass. Synthetic released-v0 log of 127,400 logical events (200 turns x 500 text + 125 reasoning deltas, Zstandard). First-open four-phase totals ~930-1020 ms; first history ~837-976 ms; first-open Agent resume ~852-1616 ms including v0-to-v6 migration; post-upgrade reopen agent-resume median 34.7 ms; 128 MB constrained-heap completion checks pass.

measurements.name: agent-continuation
measurements.evidence: 800-turn tool-heavy history (13,600 events). Request history median 68.07 ms vs 297 ms budget; tool continuation median 199.45 ms vs 1,125 ms with retained heap 23.05 MiB vs 28.75 MiB; child catalog median 324.7 ms vs 1,125 ms; shipped sdk-minimal profile continuation ~980-1050 ms totals over 100 turns and 800 real file reads.

measurements.name: terminal-io
measurements.evidence: 4/4 tests pass. Steady overflow complete median ~37-39 ms vs 125 ms budget at 4 MiB capacity; five-MiB send median 104.4 ms vs 300 ms; tiny-chunk retained heap 6.8 MB and filtered-chunk retained 8.6 MB vs 16 MiB budget.

measurements.name: long-session-browser
measurements.evidence: 4/4 tests pass on the shipped-composition Web scaffold in fresh Chromium. 240-turn history: open median 177.4 ms (budget 1125), slowest older page 181.0 ms (875), first Trajectory 263.2 ms (650), first reply 242.3 ms (2750), stream main-thread task 1457.6 ms (4500), trusted draft typing 334.6 ms (1250), complete response wall 2284.5 ms (4484). All three samples report inputOverlapped true; post-GC browser heap ~60.5 MB and 16,779 DOM nodes are diagnostics.

measurements.name: conversation-fold
measurements.evidence: 1,200 events, 1,600 compact records, 500,000 streamed deltas: large-window fold 19.5 ms vs 40 ms budget with 800 materialized Chat nodes. Delta scaling measures ~4.6-5.3x against the recalibrated 5x expectation / 6.25x bound; the CoHarness fold rebuilds location, turn-navigation, and timeline projections per window replace, so the upstream 2.5x expectation is not portable. The bound still rejects the ~11x per-delta-replay regression; see the session-open-performance-gate Agent Note.

measurements.name: active-stream-reconnect
measurements.evidence: 100,000-delta reasoning prefix: ClientAssistantStream.replace() median 13.36 ms vs 63 ms budget; post-GC retained heap 22.27 MiB vs 30 MiB; the next dense live frame remains accepted after replacement.

measurements.name: synthetic-history
measurements.evidence: 2/2 tests validate the seeded released-generation fixture: current-migration, message preservation, immutable predecessor bytes, and successor reopen before timing runs.

measurements.name: ci-gate
measurements.evidence: The required 'node 24 / benchmarks' job is carried into .github/workflows/ci.yml on standard hosted ubuntu-24.04 with an unconditional pnpm store restore, Chromium install, and pnpm run check:ci:bench under DSH_GATE_VERBOSE; all-checks-passed now requires it. scripts/ci-workflow.spec.ts pins the routing, cache, step, and 15-minute timeout invariants. Hosted-runner execution evidence does not exist yet; budgets carry the upstream 2x CI scale and endpoint-specific hosted expectations.

exclusions: No standard-hosted (ubuntu-24.04 x64) CI run has executed this lane in this fork; the measurements above are arm64 reference-machine evidence only.
Browser timings include the source-resolved test Host, transport, and Playwright actionability; they are not published-Host evidence.
conversation-fold scaling is calibrated to CoHarness's extra fold projections, not upstream's 2.5x constant.
Network transfer, real model latency, GPU presentation, sidebar cardinality, and hours-long soak remain unmeasured by design.
